redTeam.question: Can a false website defect create a refund or damage trust?
redTeam.evidence: R3: unrelated-number mismatches are never sold; typo-class only; acceptance before invoice; one correction pass. Residual: no human reproduction yet (W6).

redTeam.question: Can an agency reproduce the result?
redTeam.evidence: Reproduction steps exist per finding; zero independent reproductions performed.

redTeam.question: Can a technically correct finding still be commercially worthless?
redTeam.evidence: Structured-data parse errors are flagged by free tools; 4/4 corroborated cohort candidates are this class.

redTeam.question: Can the service consume compute on thousands of clean sites without revenue?
redTeam.evidence: 35/40 enterprise sites produced nothing; compute ~$0.01 per 40 sites (hypothetical CU); direct pilot is buyer-nominated so no speculative scanning cost.

redTeam.question: Can a customer be double-charged?
redTeam.evidence: Atomic PostgreSQL reservation (12 concurrent runs -> 1 charge, re-run 2026-10-22 on PG16); direct pilot is a single manual invoice after acceptance.

redTeam.question: Can a failed charge appear as successful?
redTeam.evidence: Unpriced Apify events refused; UNKNOWN outcomes never retried; CONFIRMED != cleared.

redTeam.question: Can a refund remain counted as retained profit?
redTeam.evidence: CLEARED tier requires PAYMENT_RETAINED PROVEN; R1 withholds all amounts on an unverifiable chain.

redTeam.question: Can a payout be misclassified as cleared before reaching the founder?
redTeam.evidence: Ledger requires trusted verification; real path must reconcile Contra payout + bank credit (Contra lifecycle vocabulary).

redTeam.question: Can an inactive payout account make an otherwise profitable product unusable?
redTeam.evidence: PayPal deactivated: #1535 route and #1537 economics corrected; rail registry R4.

redTeam.question: Can a false assumption about Egyptian eligibility invalidate the whole channel?
redTeam.evidence: Contra Egypt payout is support-confirmed but account-unobserved; sender-side marketing law unresolved.

redTeam.question: Can the outreach system send from an unready mailbox?
redTeam.evidence: sender health evidence expired 2026-10-08; ordinal 3 quarantined; outboundAuthority NONE; refresh required before any send.

redTeam.question: Can two agents modify the same branch and overwrite work?
redTeam.evidence: Claude pushed one fast-forward commit to #1537 after verifying the remote head; comment tells Chat on Steroids to fetch first; orchestration work is on a separate branch.

redTeam.question: Can a new PR weaken payment integrity inherited from another PR?
redTeam.evidence: #1537 ports #1532 integrity tests (5/5) and keeps #1536 reservation tests; R1/R2 tightened, nothing relaxed.

redTeam.question: Can a buyer receive an unclear deliverable and reject acceptance?
redTeam.evidence: Report renders clearly; buyer comprehension untested; acceptance must be explicit.

redTeam.question: Can competitor pricing make the proposed product unattractive?
redTeam.evidence: Marketplace QA ~$50; form monitoring EUR 10-$30/mo. $99 needs the verified, reproducible evidence differentiator.

redTeam.question: Can founder support time destroy the apparent margin?
redTeam.evidence: At the allocator's $10/hour shadow cost the pessimistic case stays positive (+$27 at 160 min); at the ~$30/hour implied by #1537 UNIT_ECONOMICS it turns negative (-$47 at 180 min). Early sales are information purchases, not margin.

redTeam.question: Can a positive backtest distract engineering effort from existing paying demand?
redTeam.evidence: Quant lab produced no promoted experiment; capital allocation funds nothing; no engineering is assigned to it here.
